insights.body: App Total Revenue on 10-05 vs 09-28 is +5.2%, but App Total New Subs on 09-28 vs 09-21 was -4.6% — they moved in opposite directions. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. Since those subs went the other way, this growth is coming from existing customers instead: check renewals and cancellations, refunds, or a recent price change — not marketing or installs.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YMK is turning installs into New Subs worse than usual (-9.6% vs Install -2.7%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YMK New Subs -9.6% vs Install -2.7% (worse than its installs); YCP New Subs -33.1% vs Install -7.8% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which app — App Total Install -4.1% is mostly YCP — not every app.
insights.body: App Total Install moved -4.1% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App -4.1%, YMK -2.7%, YCP -7.8%, YCV -2.4%). YCP accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.

insights.title: Which country — US is out of line with every other country on App Total New Subs (-12.7% vs -18.5%).
insights.body: For All App, App Total New Subs in US is -12.7% while all countries together are -18.5% — a gap of +5.8pp. US is about 38% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.
